courtViewDefinition: same as bwf-ws-2026: the whole playing court with all four court corners inside the frame. This amateur camera is a single low-elevation oblique wide shot from the side of the hall; the full court including both baselines is inside the frame for the entire window, so the whole window is court view.
notes:
One fixed camera, one unbroken shot, no replays, no score graphics, no cuts across the whole 301 s window. This is the zero-true-cut control for E2: every scene-change event a detector raises here is a false positive by construction. Doubles (four players), dim indoor hall, low-contrast wood floor. No rally-active interval is supplied by the camera-grammar corpus; the fixed-camera control was separately reviewed and its control decision is retained in rally-review.json.
Rally-active annotations were independently reviewed from direct playback by the captain; see rally-review.json for full interval evidence, including removed proposals and corrections.
